text: TWILIGHT SITTING 2026-09-26: THE TOP-THREE FRAMING IS REJECTED AND REPLACED BY A BETTER MECHANIC. Owner typed the above. What it establishes: (a) A SKYLIGHT DRIFTS OVER ABOUT A WEEK, not over years as the frozen sheet and both design passes assumed. That is a playable cadence a colony actually experiences, not background lore. It supersedes the sheet's 'every light-well is temporary on a years scale' timing while leaving hard ban 5 (no permanent skylight) intact. (b) THERE ARE OTHER LIGHTS THE PLAYER GROWS SLOWLY THEMSELVES - the sun-sphere / ollumin culture line. (c) 🔑 THE LOAD-BEARING INSIGHT, his: 'and this explains the movable chained floating fields.' The tethered cage farms are movable BECAUSE the light moves. Chain a floating field and walk it to follow the drifting shaft, or culture your own light and stay put. That fuses two previously separate ideas into one trade and gives the biome its arc: early game you chase the light, late game you make it and become independent of the Compact's leases. (d) It also DISSOLVES a conflict the review sheet had filed as its own row - 'the sun-sphere frees the player from the skylight economy' vs 'skylight tenancy is the #1 marquee'. Not a conflict: that IS the progression. (e) A week-long drift also rescales skylight tenancy: a Compact lease is short-term and renewed, not generational. ⇒ NO ranked top three. He asked to 'explore the others more dynamically' - the remaining four (dry river as travel lane, the gardener's events, living light, charts and ledgers) are open for design, not queued behind a fixed 1-2-3.

title: The bedazzle program: eleven biomes raised to the Baroque bar in ruled order (Contagion first, Black Crags last), four-movement ritual, nine-mark bar as the design gate; all other biomes grandfathered subject to the gate
ownerSaid: Bedazzle means we take what's there and review, fill the flora/fauna roster, then start ideating what could be REALLY awesome/unique mechanics.
